ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the food web diagram, if the supply of deer increases, what will happen to the fruit trees?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the right side of the food web diagram, the bottom oval is labeled "fruit trees." An arrow points upward from "fruit trees" to "deer," and another arrow points upward from "deer" to "bear." Reasoning: In a food web, an arrow from a food source to an animal indicates that the animal eats or depends on that food source. Since deer depend on fruit trees, an increase in deer means more deer will consume more fruit trees. Therefore, the fruit trees will decrease.
